wins: A zombie horde that keeps coming back: lords pump the team, the graveyard is a second hand, and Grave Titan ends it.
plan: Diregraf Ghoul and Gravecrawler start the horde.
Cemetery Reaper (zombie lord) and Death Baron (+1/+1 and deathtouch to other zombies); Moan of the Unhallowed adds two zombies.
Grave Titan makes zombies on entering and attacking. Flashback Moan, Gravedigger and Raise Dead rebuild after removal.
keys: Other Zombies +1/+1, and it turns creature cards in graveyards into new zombies.
Other Zombies get +1/+1 and deathtouch: every block becomes a trade.
6/6 deathtouch that makes two 2/2 zombies on entering and on every attack.
Two zombies now and two more with flashback later.
tips: Gravecrawler can be recast from your graveyard while you control another zombie.
Cemetery Reaper can eat creatures from the opponent’s graveyard too.
Doom Blade can’t hit black creatures: save Murder for those.
